about: NOAA ENC Direct, upper Galveston Bay (Houston Ship Channel by Atkinson Island, Five Mile Cut, Three Bird Island): harbour band (level 5; the approach band has no chart here) and coastal band (level 3), fetched 2026-09-28 through the /api/enc relay and replayed through the app's fetchChartArea, clipped, simplified consistently across shared edges (<= ~1.5 m per pass) and quantised to 1e-5 deg. Rings/paths are delta-encoded integers from origin [lon, lat]. Depth entries: [level, minDepthM, rings, 1 if from ENC cell US5HOUCH]. Land: [level, hazard?1:0, rings]. Channels: [d|f, rings, name?]. Hazards: [kind, radiusM, x, y]. Lines: [kind, widthM, level, path].
